# K4 LAN spectrum hardware fixtures

SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

These two files are **unmodified packets captured from a physical Elecraft K4
running release R39** on its local TCP spectrum port 9201. They were captured
and published by Robert Jackson (the author of this repository) in Ham2K HaLo:

- Source: <https://github.com/ham2k/halo/pull/3>, head commit
  `rwjblue/halo@2df35827261e30721bdd02b86c5e91e1ac7cf1fc`, directory
  `app/test/cat/fixtures/k4-spectrum/`.
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (as the HaLo repository). The Rust
  decoder in `crates/k4na-protocol/src/{frame,decoder}.rs` is a port of
  HaLo's `k4_spectrum_codec.dart` and carries the same license header.
- No network address, credentials, callsign or operator identifier is
  recorded in these bytes or this file. No private Elecraft material was
  copied.

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `k4-lan-9201-ayb.bin` | 12,486 | `c71c488ba6cbfce7d0fcac64fe4ef4a53d8932c37eac5031368f465a22090cd1` |
| `k4-lan-9201-spans-aybz.bin` | 20,810 | `a0b6ff7291a3940758e99e04fad5d52057659307f20de2e4208ddfb273ac0cfb` |

## Contents (from the HaLo fixture README)

`k4-lan-9201-ayb.bin`: the first three consecutive frames of a 20-second
capture on 2026-10-21.

| Frame | Seq | Pan | Sample rate (Hz) | Center (Hz) | Noise field (tenths) | CRC |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 12 | A | 96000 | 14045000 | -1316 | `CB08` |
| 1 | 12 | Y | 3000 | 14047440 | 87 | `2141` |
| 2 | 11 | B | 96000 | 7045000 | -1215 | `D732` |

`k4-lan-9201-spans-aybz.bin`: the first four frames of a capture connected at
`2026-10-22T00:43:30.546071Z`, then the first frame of a capture connected at
`2026-10-22T00:44:39.990655Z` (the join is not a continuous sequence).

| Frame | Seq | Pan | Sample rate (Hz) | Center (Hz) | Noise field (tenths) | CRC |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 45 | A | 24000 | 14036950 | -1392 | `A34F` |
| 1 | 45 | Y | 3000 | 14037360 | 147 | `CC19` |
| 2 | 44 | B | 96000 | 14045000 | -1101 | `7DE1` |
| 3 | 43 | Z | 3000 | 14037360 | 107 | `6887` |
| 4 | 55 | A | 48000 | 14036950 | -1340 | `38FC` |

The header fields, CRC footers and sampled bin values asserted in
`../../hardware_fixtures.rs` were independently extracted with Python's
`struct`/`binascii` modules for HaLo, not generated by this decoder.

## What this evidence does and does not establish

Established: the 4,162-byte v2 framing, header checksum, CRC-16/IBM-SDLC
footer (big-endian), ASCII header fields, A/B/Y/Z pan ids, and signed
big-endian i16 bins. Comparison with operator screenshots supports
ascending, already-centered main-pan bins (no FFT half swap).

**Not** established: calibrated dBm, sub-bin frequency accuracy, the meaning
of the 35 trailing header bytes, AutoRef/#REF/#SCL relationships, or
behavior on other firmware releases. The CAT snapshot taken during a related
capture showed `#SPN40000` while the A packets reported a 96 kHz sample rate,
and the A header center differed from VFO A. The collector therefore uses
each frame's own header for coverage and never the display span or VFO.
